'''Tibor''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Kadas'sa'Nikto/Legends|Kadas'sa'Nikto]] working for [[Lokaibus]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3637 BBY]] a shipment of beast delivered to the Hutt's [[Slavering Arenas]] was hijacked by the [[Nova Blades]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] above [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]] and [[Tibor]] was tasked with retrieving them.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tibor appears in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' expansion, released on [[December 2]], [[2014]].
